title: Mangels Vineyards
specs: Family tradition of winemaking over 100 years in Suisun Valley
includes: 20% discount on all wine purchases in-store or online
Access to all events and special discounts for ticketed events
Free tastings for up to 4 friends and family
Access to library or unreleased wines as announced
blurb: Mangels Vineyards is dedicated to making premium wines from select varietals grown in Suisun Valley, continuing a family tradition of winemaking over 100 years. They offer a wine club with three shipments per year, each consisting of 4 bottles, with options to customize selections. Members enjoy discounts, event access, free tastings, and other benefits.
highlights: Family tradition of winemaking over 100 years in Suisun Valley
